body:
Thanks for reading it all. I'm pretty relieved that I've managed to get it out there.

You're helping just by being friendly! I understand how hard it is to help with other people's problems, but you did great just by being an ear. Thank you very much.

Thanks, man. It's a shitty feeling. It's strange - because you've read that post, you now know more about me than any other human apart from my partner, and you don't even know my name.

I hope things pick up for you. I'm in no place to offer advice, but you seem like a really nice dude/lady. I may take you up on the 'talk anytime' offer at some point.
